entries.title: Theme admin list showing Local Services.
entries.notes: Capture with Foundation Theme, Layout Builder, and capell-app/theme-local-services installed in the isolated demo harness.
entries.useCase: An administrator confirms the Local Services theme is available for quote-led local operators.

entries.title: Frontend page rendered with Local Services theme.
entries.notes: Capture a seeded service business page with locality hero, services, service areas, quote form, case studies, resources, contact, proof, CTA, and footer.
entries.useCase: A local operator sees how the theme drives visitors from service need to quote request.

entries.title: Local services homepage.
entries.notes: Capture locality proof, availability signals, dispatch rhythm, and conversion-oriented hero content.
entries.useCase: A trades, maintenance, or local service team reviews whether the homepage makes coverage and response clear.

entries.title: Bookable services.
entries.notes: Capture service cards with urgency markers, pricing cues, eligibility notes, and quote actions.
entries.useCase: A visitor can compare service calls without the page feeling like an agency services grid.

entries.title: Service areas.
entries.notes: Capture postcode/area cards, route proof, and coverage-focused CTA copy.
entries.useCase: A local business proves it serves the visitor's area before asking for an enquiry.

entries.title: Quote request.
entries.notes: Capture the quote form section with static fallback and optional capell-app/form-builder state.
entries.useCase: A local operator checks that quote conversion remains obvious after service discovery.

entries.title: Job proof and case studies.
entries.notes: Capture completed-job proof, before/after-style cards, local trust markers, and case study summaries.
entries.useCase: A service business can show practical proof without overlapping Portfolio's studio case-study workflow.

entries.title: Service resources.
entries.notes: Capture advice/resource cards using static content or the optional blog integration when available.
entries.useCase: A local business can answer common service questions while keeping the quote path visible.

entries.title: Signed admin preview route.
entries.notes: Capture a signed preview URL generated for the seeded Local Services theme, site, and page.
entries.useCase: An administrator previews a local-service page with the theme applied before publishing the theme choice.
